requiredFindings.title: Check 3 compares X4B's acceptance with a P0 capsule that has no floors
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 7 check 3 says that when the retained owner was advanced in this fence hold by a floor publication or by X4B's acceptance, each of the admitted capsule's five clock.record floors (evalHighWater, lastAccepted, rootVersion, revocationVersion, indexSnapshotVersion) must be at least the same floor of every capsule the hold retained before it. The capsule retained before X4B's acceptance is the P0 state.v1, whose clock is the unevaluated phase and has no record, so none of those five fields exist. Check 1 says an unevaluated clock has nothing to compare; check 3 does not. X4B's confirming admission runs X4T items 2 to 7 after that advance and must admit the accepted store. Check 3 gives that admission no result that both follows the sentence and succeeds. Required: a predecessor whose clock is unevaluated has nothing to compare, and check 3 admits X4B's acceptance.

scope: Law X4T r8. The r7 floor-publication contradiction is real and the reference load closes it without walking history. Rollback checks 1 and 2 match the time-evidence schema, and the whole-restore limit is the selected bound. The retained owner matches item 8, X2 r5, and X4B item 5. RF-1: check 3 compares X4B's acceptance with the unevaluated P0 capsule, which has none of the five floors. No product cargo.
